a:

a trillium is a type of theium, i.e. an element, generally associated with sound waves.
although some elements are also capable of emitting sound, it is generally not possible to produce one in a known volume.

a:

yes, that is trilling (a word that means "singing"). the word "tillium" is a combination of two latin words, which i'm sure you can guess.
